def site_pose(s):
    sid = s.model.site("gripper0_right_grip_site").id
    return s.data.site_xpos[sid].copy(), s.data.site_xmat[sid].reshape(3, 3).copy()


def ik(s, target_pos, target_rot, seed=None, max_iter=120, rot_weight=0.18):
    """Damped least-squares arm IK; temporary qpos edits are restored before returning."""
    qids, dids = robot_qids(s), robot_dids(s)
    original = s.data.qpos.copy()
    q = original[qids].copy() if seed is None else np.asarray(seed, float).copy()
    limits = np.array([s.model.joint(f"robot0_joint{i}").range for i in range(1, 8)])
    sid = s.model.site("gripper0_right_grip_site").id
    jacp, jacr = np.zeros((3, s.model.nv)), np.zeros((3, s.model.nv))
    best = None
    for _ in range(max_iter):
        s.data.qpos[qids] = q
        mujoco.mj_forward(s.model, s.data)
        pos = s.data.site_xpos[sid].copy()
        rot = s.data.site_xmat[sid].reshape(3, 3).copy()
        ep = target_pos - pos
        er = Rotation.from_matrix(target_rot @ rot.T).as_rotvec()
        err = np.r_[ep, er]
        cost = np.linalg.norm(np.r_[ep, rot_weight * er])
        if best is None or cost < best[0]:
            best = (cost, q.copy(), np.linalg.norm(ep), np.linalg.norm(er))
        if np.linalg.norm(ep) < 0.008 and np.linalg.norm(er) < 0.08:
            break
        mujoco.mj_jacSite(s.model, s.data, jacp, jacr, sid)
        J = np.vstack([jacp[:, dids], rot_weight * jacr[:, dids]])
        e = np.r_[ep, rot_weight * er]
        dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + (0.025 ** 2) * np.eye(6), e)
        # Limit IK updates to keep the solver in the nearby redundant configuration.
        scale = min(1.0, 0.18 / max(1e-9, np.max(np.abs(dq))))
        q = np.clip(q + scale * dq, limits[:, 0] + 0.005, limits[:, 1] - 0.005)
    result = best[1]
    s.data.qpos[:] = original
    mujoco.mj_forward(s.model, s.data)
    return result, best[2], best[3]


def action(s, q, grip):
    a = s.initial_command().copy()
    a[:7] = q
    a[7] = grip
    a[12] = -1
    return a


def move_q(s, qgoal, grip, n=28, settle=8):
    q0 = s.data.qpos[robot_qids(s)].copy()
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        alpha = i / n
        s.step(action(s, q0 * (1 - alpha) + qgoal * alpha, grip))
    for _ in range(settle):
        s.step(action(s, qgoal, grip))


def move_ee(s, p, rot, grip, qseed=None, n=20, settle=5, rot_weight=0.1):
    q, pe, re = ik(s, np.asarray(p, float), rot, qseed, rot_weight=rot_weight)
    print("move_ee target", np.round(p, 3), "ik", round(float(pe), 4), round(float(re), 3))
    move_q(s, q, grip, n=n, settle=settle)
    return s.data.qpos[robot_qids(s)].copy()


def report(s, label):
    p, _ = site_pose(s)
    m, d = s.model, s.data
    bodies = {n: d.xpos[m.body(n).id].copy() for n in ["pan1_main", "pan2_main", "vegetable_main", "meat_main"]}
    fingers = [d.qpos[m.joint(f"gripper0_right_finger_joint{i}").qposadr[0]] for i in (1, 2)]
    contacts = []
    for ci in range(d.ncon):
        c = d.contact[ci]
        n1, n2 = m.geom(c.geom1).name, m.geom(c.geom2).name
        if any(x in n1 + n2 for x in ("pan2", "vegetable", "meat")) and "gripper0_right" in n1 + n2:
                contacts.append((n1, n2, np.round(c.pos, 3).tolist(), round(float(c.dist), 4)))
    print(label, "eef", np.round(p, 3), "fingers", np.round(fingers, 3), "pan_contacts", contacts, "objects", {k: np.round(v, 3).tolist() for k, v in bodies.items()}, "success", s.check())
